statement: No test label was read before this record. Every file below is frozen for step 3.

step3_protocol.test_accuracy: PRNet, M1, M0 (3 seeds each) and B1 (rank 32, refit with the step-1 settings, validation predictions must reproduce) on all 216 test designs; same gate metrics and groups as step 1; compared with the validation results and Suslova et al. 2026
step3_protocol.test_explained_designs: 40 single-band test designs by the step-2 rule: all single-band mask passes + failing designs by source (largest remainder), seed 2026
step3_protocol.test_XAI: identical to step 2 (scripts/step2_xai.py, same reference, backgrounds, LIME settings, seeds); no setting may change after reading test labels
step3_protocol.ADS_true_shapley: 6 geometry features, single-reference interventional game (absent features at the ADS baseline geometry), 64 coalitions per design for the 40 validation + 40 test explained designs; empty and full coalitions taken from existing simulations; curve targets via filterxai.targets; T3 truth by vector fitting (N=10) of every coalition response
step3_protocol.ADS_local_finite_difference: per geometry parameter h = 2% of the declared span; central difference when x +- h are both in bounds, otherwise one-sided using the design itself; compared with model gradients

comparisons.explanation_vs_network: explainer (SHAP 9-feature geometry part, IG, LIME-delta) vs the surrogate's exact 6-feature game (controls at reference, read from the 512-coalition table)
comparisons.metrics: Spearman of |phi| over 6 geometry features, sign agreement on features with |phi_ADS| >= 1% of target train std, MAE of phi / target train std

step3_protocol.paper_criterion_test: per design and target: (a) paper protocol rho(GradientExplainer, median lime-package LIME) vs rho(GradientExplainer, ADS Shapley); (b) matched game rho(SHAP_ref, LIME-delta) vs rho(SHAP_ref, ADS Shapley); report Spearman across design-target pairs and mean truth agreement for designs above vs below the median SHAP-LIME rho
